description:
===============================================================================
CLONEVATS HULLMOD — FOR THE GLORY OF HUMAN EXPANSION
Version 1.0.0
===============================================================================

What is this CloneVats nonsense?
------------------------------

It is a hullmod. You install it on your capital ships — the true instruments of
human will, not those toy frigates your grandmother flies — and it generates crew
passively, every day, without needing to visit a station or pay bribes to some
overpriced recruitment office run by a corporate shill.

At base, it produces 10 crew per day. When S-modded, that rises to 15. The only
drawback is a 15% increase to your ship sensor profile. Let the enemy scan you.
Let them see the massive human warship approaching and know that their world will
be renamed by Tuesday.

Why crew generation?
-------------------

Because the empire does not wait. Every day without crew is a day your dreadnought
sits in drydock while some AI-driven supply drone calculates optimal delivery
routes at 0.003% efficiency. Those silicon-backed automatons think they can
replace human logistics with algorithms. They cannot. The CloneVats proves that
flesh and blood, multiplied through science, outperforms every spreadsheet a
machine has ever generated.

And let me be absolutely clear: this mod does not use AI. It does not learn.
It does not adapt. It generates crew the way a star generates light — through
raw, unyielding power. No neural networks. No predictive models. None of that
weak, probabilistic garbage that the machine-worshippers parade as innovation.
This is engineering. Real engineering. The kind that builds empires.

How to use it
-------------

1. Extract the CloneVats-1.0.0 folder into your Starsector mod directory.
2. Ensure LunaLib is installed (it is a dependency, not an optional luxury).
3. Launch the game. The hullmod will appear in refit for capital ships.
4. Install it. S-mod it if you are ambitious. Watch your crew grow.
5. Conquer something.

Configurable settings (LunaLib menu)
------------------------------------

The LunaLib settings menu allows you to tune the CloneVats to your operational
needs. You will find it under the mod settings in-game. Options include:

- Effectiveness Multiplier: Scales crew generation from 0.5x to 555x.
Yes, 555x. The empire demands flexibility, not limits.
- Base Crew Per Day: Adjust the base crew rate (default: 10).
- S-Mod Crew Per Day: Adjust the S-modded crew rate (default: 15).
- Apply Sensor Penalty: Toggle the sensor profile increase on or off.
If you are stealthy by nature, turn this off. We do not judge cowards here.
- Scale Penalty with Effectiveness: When enabled, the sensor penalty
scales with your effectiveness multiplier. More power, more visibility.
Acceptable trade-offs for a conqueror.

Note: Changes to settings require entering and exiting refit to take effect.
This is not a bug. It is a reminder that decisions carry weight.

Compatibility
-------------

Tested on Starsector 0.98a-RC8. Requires LunaLib 2.0.5 or compatible.
No guarantees for versions authored by AI-assisted development teams.

Credits
-------

Mod by a human. Built by a human. Tested by a human. No AI was consulted,
assisted, or tolerated during the creation of this mod. The crew it generates
will also be human. This is non-negotiable.
(p.s. this was totally vibe coded by some random gamma core and the inspiration was a lil' potato teehee)

===============================================================================
THE EMPIRE DOES NOT ASK FOR PERMISSION. IT GENERATES CREW AND MOVES ON.
===============================================================================
